fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 correctly detects that U0 is undefined without an actual family C_S and precise transformation rules, but its formula still conflates pointwise bounded syntax with one uniform fixed template across S. It is a necessary specification repair, not a frontier experiment or a proof of exclusion.

Proposal 2 is the sole viable bounded direction, conditional on proving that each permitted equality expansion contracts to the original support graph and that all four precisely defined fixed-template classes have template-bounded treewidth. Neither assertion currently has verifier evidence, and measured treewidth at three sizes cannot become asymptotic U0.

Proposal 3 relies on an unstated cut-rank definition and an unproved stability lemma under equality elimination. Small-field rank profiles at S=8,16,32 would not show that every balanced decomposition has growing rank, so this is not yet a discriminating experiment.

Proposal 4 assumes fixed-block presentations are bounded-adhesion matroid sums and that every allowed equality expansion is a bounded-adhesion series/parallel extension. Those claims are substantially stronger than the ROADMAP rules and currently unsupported, so the proposed minor search cannot certify U0.

Proposal 5 is false as stated for two-stage systems: the fixed-template equations x+y_i=0 for i=1,...,n have the primitive kernel generator (1,-1,...,-1), meeting every scenario interface. Thus no uniform bounded-interface Graver-type obstruction covers all four target classes.

Proposal 6 has no established implication from the four standard matrix classes to bounded twin-width, and arbitrary permitted equality gadgets are not shown to preserve it. SAT contraction searches at sizes 8 and 16 would provide neither a certified lower bound nor a uniform exclusion.

Proposal 7 can decisively refute a frozen U0 grammar if SAT finds a valid representation, but bounded UNSAT for selected K,q,w,S cannot support the required quantifiers. DRAT certificates validate only the Boolean encoding unless a separate soundness theorem connects that encoding to the exact standard classes.

None of these U0 proposals addresses DROP, signed affine kernels, carry/lumpability, or recurrence growth. That is acceptable at the declared U0 frontier, but no passing U0 experiment may be cited as progress on U2-U4 or the target GapCVP theorem.
evidence: ROADMAP declares U0 the current frontier and specifically requests serialized sizes 8,16,32 with fixed-block recognition and a growing separator invariant. It also limits U0 to excluding direct known-class formulations rather than arbitrary extended formulations.

No supplied verifier serializes the proposed universal-circuit factors or proves any treewidth, cut-rank, branch-width, twin-width, or grammar-recognition claim. The available verifier evidence concerns earlier finite gadget failures and cannot validate these proposals.

For D_S=[I -C_S], identity columns are leaves in the bipartite support graph, so genuine growing treewidth must come from the serialized C_S detector/separator incidence. A certified growing grid or expander minor would therefore test Proposal 2's stated causal mechanism directly.

The prior evidence repeatedly shows that finite passes do not imply composition or asymptotic growth. The same restriction applies here: even increasing certified minors at three sizes would only justify attempting a uniform minor induction.
next_experiment: Hash-freeze precise U0 grammars, allowed equality gadgets, and one concrete universal-circuit serializer for C_8,C_16,C_32, then run only Proposal 2. Emit each support graph, exact or certified treewidth bounds, machine-checkable tree decompositions and bramble/grid-minor certificates, and explicit contraction maps for every allowed equality gadget; reject the mechanism if the serialized family exhibits a reusable bounded-width decomposition, and otherwise require minors of predeclared increasing orders before attempting an asymptotic induction. Do not test signed shells or depth recurrence in this run.
